citation: Meng X, Fu Z, Zhao W, Wu X, Ma C, Feng Y, Du S, Zhao X, Wang Y, Han Y. Association Mapping of Seedling Resistance to Fusarium graminearum Root Rot and Development of KASP Assays in Soybean
what_it_anchors: Per-assay KASP outcome for a soybean panel: 2 of 6 prioritised exonic SNPs converted, both worked; per-assay screening efficiency 19/26=73.08% and 26/35=74.29%
claim: Six exonic SNPs in six candidate genes were prioritised (Table 1); two were submitted to KASP (KASP-S17_32244510 C/T Glyma.17g202500, KASP-S18_55105706 A/G Glyma.18g266700) and both resolved homozygous genotype clusters on 336 accessions; 308 accessions gave unambiguous homozygous calls at both loci; the remaining four SNPs were never submitted, so the paper reports no failed assay
access_detail: full text XML read; the 4 unsubmitted SNPs are selection, not failure; MDPI supplementary Table S7 (primer sequences) not read (403), so no sequence is cited from it

citation: Rosso ML, Shang C, Song Q, Escamilla D, Gillenwater J, Zhang B. Development of Breeder-Friendly KASP Markers for Low Concentration of Kunitz Trypsin Inhibitor in Soybean Seeds
what_it_anchors: KASP conversion denominator for soybean: 5 trait-associated SNPs, 3 converted to KASP and validated on 93 PIs; selection efficiency 64/86/31 %
claim: Five SNPs were significantly associated with KTI content (Table 7); three (Gm08_44265646, Gm08_44814503, Gm08_45317135) were converted to KASP assays and were polymorphic on 93 PIs with selection efficiencies of 64 %, 86 % and 31 %; SNPs with no call and monomorphic SNPs between parents were discarded and are not enumerated
access_detail: full text XML read; the 2 non-converted SNPs were dropped for linkage/polymorphism in the mapping parents, not reported as failed assays, so the 3/5 is a conversion denominator and not a failure rate
